body:
BUG-2531 r3 is done by the integration seat. The cause was a few lines in one file. Commit 4dd161d is on local integ-p17, not pushed yet; make check-ci-fast is running now.
Cause: this was never a flake. BUG-2531 fails it on every run. Evidence: #4156's own PR CI at 6423e93 failed bug_2517 (run 43876073391, lib-1), and at cdeb67b it failed 200/200 solo runs on dell1.
How it happens: in load_view_with_budget, change_events -> filter_events -> fold_owners reads the label's by-spec index hint (BUG-2403.json, 51 bytes) on the discovery's WORK budget. Discovery.hints cached it as "charged to the first caller's budget", so the later spec_entries selection never paid for it. The selection then succeeded at corpus+hints-51, and the test's one-byte-short refusal failed.
Fix (aida-cli-lib/src/gate/ledger/checked.rs only): the hint cache now works like Cached.selected. It records the hint's bytes and charges a selection once, whichever budget paid for the read. owner_set/index_hint take a selection flag; fold_owners passes false, spec_changes passes true. No tolerance change, and the test is unchanged.
Evidence: on dell1, 60/60 consecutive solo passes under load (load average 21-25). gate:: had 1578 passed and 1 failed (bug_2398 dispatch flow); that one also fails at the baseline without the patch (dell1 environment).
Next: once check-ci-fast exits 0, I push 4dd161d to integration and promote/integration-17, which refreshes #4187 and reruns full CI. Please confirm whether 4dd161d needs an independent review before the train (it is a new code commit on integration).
subject: BUG-2531 r3: root cause found and fixed (4dd161d), not a flake
